## Current benchmarks

### [Study 01: Separated-locus fine-mapping](01_finemapping/report.qmd)

Ten replicates and 40 fits evaluate marker recovery, causal ranks, and
credible-set coverage under an explicit one-chain development contract.
[Current capsule](../results/reference/01_finemapping/current/README.md).

### [Study 02: Single-trait prediction](02_prediction/report.qmd)

Two architectures, five paired replicates, four methods, and 40 four-chain fits
evaluate held-out prediction using training-only scaling, summary statistics,
and LD. [Current capsule](../results/reference/02_prediction/current/README.md).

### [Study 03: Single-trait parameter estimation](03_parameter_estimation/report.qmd)

Two architectures, five replicates, four methods, and 40 four-chain fits evaluate
posterior recovery, uncertainty, and matched versus misspecified priors.
[Current capsule](../results/reference/03_parameter_estimation/current/README.md).

### [Study 04: Multichain convergence](04_convergence/report.qmd)

Four maximum-history fits (16 chains) select current operational settings. A
separate 20-fit, 80-chain, five-replicate stage validates those recommendations.
[Selection capsule](../results/reference/04_convergence/current-selection/README.md) ·
[validation capsule](../results/reference/04_convergence/current-validation/README.md).

### [Study 05: LD-operator validation](05_ld_operator/report.qmd)

Two architectures, five paired replicates, six configurations, and 60 four-chain
fits validate packed BED, full and block CSR, and retained-low-rank operators.
The fits retain their original compatible package SHA; deterministic validation
against the current refresh SHA proves unchanged resolved priors and scalar
sampler transitions. The same integrated study tests exact, hard-sparse, and
block-eigen SBayesR operators in one deterministic LD-rich window.
[Integrated capsule](../results/reference/05_ld_operator/current/README.md).

## In development

### [Study 06: Annotation-informed models](06_annotation_models/annotation-convergence.qmd)

**Status: In development.** The interface audit and two four-chain
maximum-history fits completed. The prespecified convergence stop condition was
triggered for both annotation-aware methods, so no five-replicate scientific
benchmark was started.
[Current stop capsule](../results/reference/06_annotation_models/current-stop/README.md).

### Study 07: Multivariate implementation validation

**Status: In development.** Planned/paused pending retained-low-rank MT implementation and scalar-to-MT
extension work. Preserved alignment, state-mapping, covariance, checkpoint, and
runtime infrastructure is not presented as current scientific evidence.

Earlier development benchmark versions remain available through Git history.
